events.title: 'Imagine' Album Turns 55
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic solo album 'Imagine' was released on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine at 55
angles.copy: 55 years ago today, John Lennon released his seminal album 'Imagine'. Still sounds as powerful and relevant as ever, doesn't it?

events.title: Sting turns 75
events.blurb: The legendary Police frontman and solo artist Sting celebrates his 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Sting
angles.copy: Happy 75th to Sting! From The Police to his incredible solo career, a true musical icon. What's your favourite Sting track?

events.title: Original iPod Turns 25
events.blurb: The first generation Apple iPod, revolutionising portable music, was released 25 years ago today.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember life before the iPod? 25 years ago today, Apple changed how we listened to music forever with the launch of the original device.

events.title: Happy James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Bond Day
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred. It's James Bond Day! Celebrating 007 and over six decades of iconic espionage on screen.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today marks what would have been the 86th birthday of The Beatles legend and peace activist, John Lennon.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. An unparalleled songwriter and a voice for a generation.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic Monty Python and Fawlty Towers star, John Cleese, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Happy 87th to the one and only John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true master of British comedy.

events.title: 'The White Album' Turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released 58 years ago today in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles delivered 'The White Album'. What's your favourite track from that incredible double LP?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks the 35th anniversary of the passing of legendary Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: 35 years since we lost a true showman. Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury and his extraordinary musical legacy today.

events.title: 'Rubber Soul' Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released 61 years ago today in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: 61 years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Rubber Soul'. A pivotal album that changed the sound of the 60s. What's your go-to track?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic passing of music icon John Lennon.

angles.name: John Lennon Remembrance
angles.copy: 46 years ago today, the world lost John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to resonate globally.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Today marks what would have been the 80th birthday of the visionary music and style icon, David Bowie.

angles.name: Remembering David Bowie
angles.copy: Remembering the Starman. David Bowie would have been 80 today, a true legend whose influence is still felt everywhere.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock 'n' Roll, Elvis Presley, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Elvis
angles.copy: Long live The King! Celebrating what would have been Elvis Presley's 92nd birthday. Still sounds incredible.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist and producer Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Jimmy Page
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the guitar wizard, Jimmy Page! The architect of Led Zeppelin's iconic sound.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Rock and pop icon Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Rod Stewart
angles.copy: Happy 82nd to the one and only Rod Stewart! Still rocking and still got that incredible voice.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham 'Suggs' McPherson, the charismatic frontman of Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Suggs
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to Suggs, the legendary frontman of Madness! Still bringing the house down.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: The British pop and soul singer Paul Young, known for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat', celebrates his 71st birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Paul Young
angles.copy: Happy 71st to Paul Young! Still got that incredible voice and those timeless hits.
